findings.evidence: grep '^namespace' over TauCeti/AlgebraicTopology/SimplicialComplex: only OrderComplex.lean:47 and Subdivision.lean:54 contain `namespace TauCeti`; Basic.lean:18 `namespace AbstractSimplicialComplex`, Maps.lean:24 `namespace PreAbstractSimplicialComplex`, likewise Cone.lean:54, Join.lean:43, Product.lean:45, LinkStar.lean:60, Dimension.lean:60, Realization.lean:48.
findings.fix: Delete the `namespace TauCeti` / `end TauCeti` wrapper in both files and drop the resulting `_root_.` prefixes, matching the rest of the directory.
findings.issue: Both new files wrap their declarations in `namespace TauCeti`, so the canonical names are `TauCeti.AbstractSimplicialComplex.orderComplex`, `TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.barycentricSubdivision`, `TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.SimplicialMap.barycentricMap`. Every other file extending these Mathlib types (Basic, Maps, Cone, Join, Product, LinkStar, Dimension, Realization, Simplex/*, Collapse/*) declares directly into the root `AbstractSimplicialComplex`/`PreAbstractSimplicialComplex` namespaces. The result is one conceptual API split across two namespaces, none of the new declarations sits in the namespace of the type it is about, and the files need ~20 `_root_.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.SimplicialMap` / `_root_.AbstractSimplicialComplex.mem_toPreAbstractSimplicialComplex` escapes to reach the existing API. Same problem in Subdivision.lean:54.

findings.evidence: Subdivision.lean:50 is `public section`, not `@[expose] public section` (contrast Mathlib/AlgebraicTopology/SimplicialComplex/Basic.lean:36 `@[expose] public section`); Subdivision.lean:78,87,93 prove the mirrored lemmas by direct appeal to the orderComplex versions, which only typechecks inside the defining module.
findings.fix: Add `theorem barycentricSubdivision_eq_orderComplex (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex α) : barycentricSubdivision K = AbstractSimplicialComplex.orderComplex (BarycentricVertex K) := (rfl)` and `theorem barycentricMap_eq_orderComplexMap (f) : barycentricMap f = AbstractSimplicialComplex.orderComplexMap (faceOrderHom f) := (rfl)`.
findings.issue: `barycentricSubdivision` is a plain `def` under `public section` (no `@[expose]`), so its body is not visible downstream, and no lemma states `barycentricSubdivision K = orderComplex (BarycentricVertex K)`. Consumers therefore cannot transfer any order-complex lemma to a subdivision — `orderComplex_eq_top` is already unreachable, and so is every future one. The file works around this by hand-mirroring three lemmas (mem_, pair_mem_, comparable_), which is exactly the duplication the equation would avoid. Same for `barycentricMap` (line 124) versus `orderComplexMap (faceOrderHom f)`; only the coercion is restated.

findings.evidence: TauCeti/AlgebraicTopology/SimplicialComplex/Basic.lean:21 `abbrev Face {ι} (K : AbstractSimplicialComplex ι) := {σ : Finset ι // σ ∈ K}`, used in Realization.lean:87,103,256 and Simplex/Realization.lean:53; Subdivision.lean:62 declares the identical subtype under a new name.
findings.fix: Introduce `PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.Face` (in Basic.lean, next to the existing one), define `AbstractSimplicialComplex.Face K := Face K.toPreAbstractSimplicialComplex`, and delete `BarycentricVertex`; `barycentricSubdivision K : AbstractSimplicialComplex K.Face`. Both are `abbrev`s, so this is a rename with no proof changes.
findings.issue: `BarycentricVertex K := {σ : Finset α // σ ∈ K}` duplicates the already-public `AbstractSimplicialComplex.Face K := {σ : Finset ι // σ ∈ K}`, under a second name for the same notion ("a face of K", nothing barycentric about it) — two names for one type in the same directory.

findings.evidence: OrderComplex.lean:99 `(mem_orderComplex_iff.mp hσ).2 (by exact_mod_cast hp) (by exact_mod_cast hq) hpq`; Subdivision.lean:77 states the criterion as `IsChain (· ≤ ·) (↑τ : Set (BarycentricVertex K))` while the docstring at line 72 promises "totally ordered by inclusion".
findings.fix: Add `mem_orderComplex_iff' : σ ∈ orderComplex P ↔ σ.Nonempty ∧ ∀ p ∈ σ, ∀ q ∈ σ, p ≤ q ∨ q ≤ p` and the subdivision counterpart stated with `(σ : Finset α) ⊆ τ ∨ (τ : Finset α) ⊆ σ`.
findings.issue: The Finset-level characterization is one-directional: `comparable_of_mem_orderComplex` is the elimination rule, but there is no introduction rule or `iff` in the same terms — the only intro route is `mem_orderComplex_iff`, whose chain condition is stated on the coercion `(↑σ : Set P)`, forcing every consumer into the coercion massaging the file itself performs at lines 60 and 99. Same gap at Subdivision.lean:90, where `comparable_of_mem_barycentricSubdivision` states nesting in `⊆` terms but `mem_barycentricSubdivision_iff` states the chain in subtype-order terms, with no `⊆`-level iff for faces of more than two vertices.

summary: The new surface is placed in `TauCeti.AbstractSimplicialComplex`/`TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex`, splitting it from every other TauCeti extension of these Mathlib types, and it duplicates the existing `Face` subtype under a new name. The subdivision also has no equation to the order complex, so with bodies unexposed none of the order-complex API is reachable downstream.
